setup_behavior.candidate_setup: The candidate ptest performed the declared setup when its private setup fingerprint baseline was absent; its observed output was Resolved 10 packages in 0.93ms and Audited 7 packages in 0.18ms. Later runs used the recorded private baseline when unchanged.
setup_behavior.setup_child_policy: The guard preserves ordinary non-PTEST caller environment, strips the entire PTEST_ namespace before setup, and supplies only six non-secret run identity variables to the setup child; declared setup is guard-owned and honors its configured network and lifecycle-script implications.
setup_behavior.manual_setup: No manual uv sync, package installation, bootstrap, raw runner, remote, cloud or legacy fallback was used.

fixes.F1: Missing private fingerprint baseline is stale; lock changes force declared setup and --no-setup refuses before launch.
fixes.F2: Fingerprint includes deterministic resolved setup executable identity and bytes, plus declared setup inputs.
fixes.F3: Setup environment strips the grant nonce and the complete PTEST_ namespace before setup.
fixes.F4: Successful setup followed by cancellation is represented as a truthful incomplete cancellation without protocol-mismatch noise or execution launch.
fixes.F5: Successful setup is recorded as phase setup/a001 with setup timing before execution phase/a001; setup failures preserve truthful status and timing.
fixes.H1: All setup failures are exit_origin setup with runner_exit_code null; setup raw status belongs to the setup attempt and execution is not launched.
fixes.M1: A successful setup attempt remains PASSED/0 when a later gate or report publication makes the overall result incomplete.
fixes.M2: Slash-containing relative setup tools resolve from checkout.root and remain stable when invoked from a subdirectory.
fixes.M3: Dangling required-path symlinks are missing after lstat plus target stat validation.
fixes.M4: where explains guard-owned declared setup with network/lifecycle implications while retaining automatic, shadow and probe limitations.
fixes.L1: Removed the unreachable setup-phase ordering clause.
fixes.L2: Removed the no-op unconsumed report cleanup disjunct.
fixes.L3: Removed the redundant setup_supported predicate and its adapter-seam bypass.
fixes.L4: Setup receives exact six identity PTEST_ names after complete PTEST_ namespace stripping.
fixes.third_audit_low_inputs: Root setup lock/manifest inputs include regular files and symlinks whose resolved targets are regular files; direct non-regular paths are safely omitted, while dangling/unsafe symlink targets and genuine regular-file read failures remain state-unavailable.
fixes.third_audit_low_where: where retains the guard-owned setup/network/lifecycle statement and the allowed pytest_collection_finish effective-item mutation caveat.
fixes.documentation: tests/ng/fixtures/pytest/README.md now distinguishes ptest's guard-owned declared setup from its unchanged adapter fixtures, which retain superseded pre-admission assertions, do not provision, and require a later authorized update.
fixes.final_precise_low_path_scan: Bare setup-tool PATH scanning catches OSError from unusable entries such as a regular-file path entry and continues without an OSError leak; the direct regression proves typed/passable setup.
fixes.final_precise_low_revalidation: Setup revalidation catches C.Problem and OSError, including private fingerprint recording errors, and returns a typed state-unavailable/incomplete result without starting execution.
